title: Artificial intelligence in education and learning outcomes: protocol for a systematic review (synthetic demonstration)
amendment_plan: Amendments are saved as new protocol versions with date, description and rationale, linked to the criteria version in force, and reported in the final review.
context: Formal education settings from primary to higher education.
rationale: Synthetic example text: AI tools are spreading in education, but evidence on learning outcomes is scattered across disciplines and databases.

objectives.question: In learners in formal education, what is the association between use of AI-based tools and learning outcomes compared with no or non-AI support?

eligibility.study_characteristics: Empirical studies (experimental, quasi-experimental, observational) on AI in education; excludes commentaries and studies without relevant outcomes.
eligibility.report_characteristics: Published 2020-2025; any language with an English abstract; journal articles and conference papers.

data_management: Records, decisions and hashes are kept in the slr-workbench ledgers and exported with manifests.
selection_process: Two independent reviewers screen titles/abstracts and full texts after a pilot calibration round; disagreements are adjudicated by a third reviewer. Agreement is reported with Cohen's kappa and PABAK.
data_collection_process: One reviewer proposes source-anchored extraction items; a second reviewer approves each item.
data_items: Study design, population, setting, AI tool, comparator, outcomes, effect estimates, limitations.

outcomes.prioritization: Achievement measured by objective assessment is prioritized over self-report.

risk_of_bias: Appropriate validated tools by design (e.g. RoB 2 for randomized trials, ROBINS-I for non-randomized studies), assessed independently by two reviewers.

synthesis.criteria: Meta-analysis when at least three studies report comparable outcomes and designs.
synthesis.methods: Random-effects meta-analysis of standardized mean differences with REML; heterogeneity via tau-squared and I-squared.
synthesis.additional_analyses: Subgroups by education level and AI tool type; sensitivity analysis excluding high risk of bias studies.

meta_bias: Funnel plots and Egger's test when at least ten studies contribute; selective outcome reporting checked against registrations.
dissemination: Peer-reviewed publication with open review data.
